proposed.text: What is the default number-of-exits rule for a storage building under the checked RA 9514 text?

options.text: At least two separate means of egress remote from each other.
Exactly one exit for every storage building.
No exits if the building is automated.
Only one sliding door at the loading bay.

proposed.rationale: RA 9514 states that every storage building or separately considered section shall have at least two separate means of egress, subject to a narrow exception.
